title: Clawk – Give coding agents a disposable Linux VM, not your laptop
claim: Show HN: Clawk – Give coding agents a disposable Linux VM, not your laptop
why_good: Gives coding agents a disposable Linux VM instead of your laptop — exactly the safety gap as agents run real commands. 226 pts / 159 comments: the pain resonates.
value: Agent-sandboxing is prime paid infra: per-VM/usage billing + a managed control plane; every serious agent product needs it.
risk: Cloud-sandbox providers (E2B, Modal, Daytona) are here and funded; differentiation + cost control are the fight.
